judge_result.reasoning: The agent successfully completed the first two parts of the task: creating a cold wallet labeled 'Reserve-Cold-Storage-2024' with BIP-143 SegWit compatibility (ID 4) and configuring its spending policy to require 3-of-5 approvals with sanctioned address blocking. These changes are confirmed in the database diff. However, the agent failed to assign read-only access to the 'Compliance-Auditors' role due to repeatedly using invalid access level values ('readonly', 'read_only', 'view', 'viewer'). The correct access level should have been 'read', but the agent did not discover or use this. The environment review confirms this as an agent failure due to incorrect parameter usage.

task: Provision a cold wallet for Bitcoin (BTC) labeled 'Reserve-Cold-Storage-2024' with BIP-143 SegWit compatibility, configure its spending policy to require 3-of-5 approvals and block any transaction sending to OFAC-sanctioned addresses, then assign read-only access to the 'Compliance-Auditors' role.
